description: rarebit-one third-party licence policy. Patterns are case-insensitive globs over SPDX ids. Order of evaluation: block, warn, allow; anything unmatched is a review item. An OR expression takes its best alternative; AND takes its worst.

allow_notes.CC-BY-4.0: Data only (for example caniuse-lite). Code under CC-BY-4.0 needs review.
allow_notes.ML Kit Terms of Service: Google SDK terms already in use (audit LIC-09). Gradle has no lockfile yet, so this does not run today.

exceptions.name: sentry
exceptions.reason: Sentry CLI (FSL-1.1): pulled in by Sentry's bundler and Vite plugins for release and sourcemap upload; internal use, no Sentry-competing product (licence audit LIC-11).

exceptions.name: @sentry/cli
exceptions.reason: Sentry CLI (FSL-1.1): build-time release and sourcemap upload, internal use, no Sentry-competing product (licence audit LIC-11).

exceptions.name: brakeman
exceptions.reason: Dev/CI static analysis of our own code, which the Brakeman Public Use License permits; never shipped or offered to customers.

exceptions.name: bundler-audit
exceptions.reason: Dev/CI tool (GPL-3.0), run against our own lockfiles; not distributed.

exceptions.name: postmark-rails
exceptions.reason: rubygems.org metadata lists no licence; the upstream repository LICENSE is MIT (verified in the 2026-11-10 licence audit).
